source.repository: external: FasterXML/jackson-databind (https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind), cloned locally for this review

groundTruth.description: Fixes CVE-2026-50193 / GHSA-3wrr-7qpf-2prh: reading deeply-nested JSON into a JsonNode via ObjectMapper.readTree() then calling JsonNode.toString() could throw StackOverflowError, because toString() recursed once per nesting level with no depth bound - a cheap, 1000s-of-levels-deep, few-KB input could exhaust the call stack. The fix rewrites the recursive toString()/writeObject() path in InternalNodeMapper.java into an explicit-stack, non-recursive traversal. First corpus case in Java/Maven, and the largest single-function rewrite reviewed so far (105 changed lines).

evidence.note: non-recursive rewrite of the JsonNode serialization-to-string path

groundTruth.confirmingFix: this commit itself; see GHSA-3wrr-7qpf-2prh and https://github.com/FasterXML/jackson-databind/issues/3447

runs.outcomeNote: All three reviewers completed with zero findings, correctly not flagging the rewrite's unfamiliar explicit-stack control flow as risky despite it being the largest single-file rewrite in the corpus so far. Matches the known-fix ground truth.

notes: This case is also what surfaced a real bug in evals/scripts/scope-policy.js: jackson-databind's tree has ~19,000 tracked files, and the prior per-file-literal exclude-list generator produced a 1.7MB, 18,708-entry policy.json. Fixed the generator to collapse whole excluded subtrees into single dir/** globs (now 98 entries), and separately found that the per-file escaping it used for special glob characters was itself incompatible with src/core/preflight.js's glob compiler, which refuses any glob containing ?{}[] or a backslash with no escape mechanism - meaning an escaped literal would have been rejected anyway. Neither bug happened to trigger on any of cases 001-009's actual trees, but both are real; see STATE.md for the full fix record. All corpus cases' policies were regenerated with the fixed generator and reverified to produce identical included/excluded scope counts before this case was added.
